scope: Experiential Bridge: tool/chat/room effects -> consciousness.activity_log -> E-PQ / narrative reflection / GWS / idle-context coupling; causal instrumentation, replay limitations and emergence/GWT implications

non_overlap_check.boundary: Prior PF authority/context receipts own execution permission and prompt/tool routing. This receipt owns post-effect observation, persistence and re-entry into cognitive state.

chronology.finding: Experiential Bridge introduced direct cross-process SQLite recording of core-proxy tools, agentic tools, chats and entity sessions into consciousness.db activity_log. Tool success/failure also fired E-PQ events; entity sessions recorded pre/post mood, a narrative reflection and mood-delta-dependent feedback. Daily SQL activity summaries were injected into idle-thought prompts.
chronology.interpretation: This is a strong historical precursor to effect->outcome->re-entry instrumentation: external action became durable-enough state that could alter future cognition instead of vanishing after the response.

chronology.finding: The same audit fixed important bridge defects: cross-process get_consciousness_daemon() calls had instantiated heavyweight daemons in the wrong processes; proxy failures were previously not recorded; entity-experience UPDATE WHERE MAX(id) could race; agentic executor lacked E-PQ events.
chronology.interpretation: Historical negative results show why effect telemetry must be process-safe, append-oriented, include failures, and avoid race-prone post-hoc row mutation.

chronology.finding: Frozen-head core/app.py and agentic/executor.py retain direct activity_log writes. consciousness_daemon retains a 500-row activity ring buffer, structured room experience recording, narrative reflection, GWS room_session_complete broadcast and daily activity summaries. Daily summaries are no longer injected into all deep thoughts; they are restricted to data-driven prompt classes because raw metric injection caused prompt leakage/semantic conflict.
chronology.interpretation: The bridge survived but evolved toward selective re-entry. This is evidence against indiscriminate global broadcast of every metric into every cognitive context.

core_proxy_recording.context: first recognized payload key among query/text/path/title/name/command/event_id, truncated

agentic_recording.context: failure error only; success context empty

frozen_head_mechanism.daily_summary_reentry: selective at frozen head; data-oriented prompt paths rather than unconditional deep-thought injection

negative_results_constraints.claim: Calling a process-local heavyweight consciousness singleton from unrelated processes was an architecture defect; the bridge had to switch to cross-process-safe direct persistence.
A telemetry path that omits failures biases the self/world model; proxy failures initially were not recorded and were explicitly fixed.
Race-prone UPDATE of the most recent experience row is unsafe under concurrent inserts; the bridge moved to a single INSERT with correct pre/post mood values.
The frozen-head 500-row ring buffer is not a durable replay/evidence ledger because old effect observations are intentionally deleted.
negative_results_constraints.falsifier: An independently immutable complete event/effect ledger is proven to retain the same events with stable correlation IDs and raw evidence.

negative_results_constraints.claim: Frozen-head bridge records are insufficient for deterministic effect replay: core-proxy records keep only one truncated input hint, no raw result/hash, no request/capability/plan/claim correlation, duration=0; agentic successful calls generally omit inputs/results from this activity record.
core proxy success defaults to true when a response dict lacks an explicit ok field, so activity success is not a universally strong outcome contract.

Unconditional raw daily-activity injection into deep thoughts was not stable; frozen-head code restricts daily metrics because raw numbers conflicted with deep-thought prompts and caused prompt leakage.
Recording external action and feeding it into mood/E-PQ/GWS is evidence of functional re-entry and causal coupling architecture, not evidence of phenomenal subjective experience.
Tool success/failure -> E-PQ is a coarse credit signal; successful execution is not equivalent to goal correctness, epistemic truth or beneficial user outcome.

reusable_candidates.mechanism: effect/outcome event re-enters future cognitive state
pre/post state and effect duration for bounded episodes
selective daily/activity re-entry rather than universal broadcast

architecture_delta.preferred_testable_shape: model proposal -> validated capability -> effect request_id -> executor -> raw effect/outcome receipt with input/result hashes, timings, pre/post state and error -> immutable append-only event history -> derived activity/experience projection -> selective GWT/context re-entry -> later outcome measurement -> causal linkage back to proposal/claim/goal
architecture_delta.measurement_obligation: Test whether truthful effect/outcome re-entry causally improves later decisions using replay, shuffled-reentry controls, lesion/rescue and matched no-reentry baselines.

branch_feedback.frank: DELTA: preserve external-action-to-self/world-model closure, but derive experience state from authoritative effect/outcome receipts rather than lossy activity telemetry. Separate execution success, goal outcome and affective/intrinsic response.
branch_feedback.harness: HIGH-PRIORITY: every effect should receive a stable request/effect/outcome ID, input/result hashes, capability decision, timing, pre/post state and rollback link. Add failure-path completeness tests and shuffled-vs-truthful re-entry experiments.
branch_feedback.claycode: DELTA: encode effect proposal, authorization, execution, receipt, outcome and later re-entry as distinct typed transitions. An activity summary is a derived projection only.
branch_feedback.unifieddb: DELTA: replace ring-buffer-as-history with immutable append-only effect/outcome events plus bounded derived views. Preserve raw refs while allowing compact daily/experience projections.
branch_feedback.claygraph: DELTA: actions/outcomes become provenance-bearing temporal edges; narrative reflections and mood interpretations remain derived nodes with links to source receipts.
branch_feedback.gwt: HIGH-VALUE DELTA: Experiential Bridge is a concrete historical precursor for effect->outcome->re-entry closure. Test causal broadcast utility with truthful-vs-shuffled re-entry, lesion/rescue and delayed-outcome measures.
branch_feedback.emergenz: DELTA: bridge supplies an intervention surface for causal integration tests; do not count self-referential telemetry as emergence without interaction/synergy and counterfactual evidence.
branch_feedback.hyperposition: DELTA: pre-outcome candidate interpretations can remain unresolved; commit authoritative event facts first, then attach competing derived interpretations.
branch_feedback.clay: DELTA: physical bridge modules may dissolve, but semantic separation of effect receipt, derived experience projection and re-entry must survive module collapse.
branch_feedback.q12_index: DELTA: Experiential Bridge lineage is reusable architecture history; no earned-work hours added until row-level deduplication.
